description: Send a fax to a US or Canada phone number. Accepts PDF, DOC, DOCX, JPG, JPEG, TXT files (max 10), as base64-encoded content in files or as links in attachments (how ChatGPT passes files the user attached). Uses one page credit per page from the authenticated account, deducted when the fax is queued and returned if it fails to send; the account must have enough credits for the whole document.

attachments.description: Files passed by link instead of content. ChatGPT fills this in with files the user attached to the conversation; any other client may give https links. Same formats as files, and files and attachments together count toward the file limit.

file_id.description: The app's id for the file

mime_type.description: The file's media type, for example application/pdf

fax_number.description: Destination fax number (10 digits, US or Canada)

files.description: Files to fax, as base64-encoded content. Either files or attachments is required.

notify_url.description: Optional URL to receive fax completion notification

name: send_fax
title: Send Fax from Prepaid Account
